_comment: Canonical capability matrix. Browser statuses are derived from the implementation in static/js/ and each carries an `evidence` field naming what was verified. Python, CLI and REST describe the pacs008 package, which lives in a separate repository and cannot be verified from this build; see interface_provenance.

status_values.stable: Implemented, covered by fixtures, safe to rely on
status_values.beta: Implemented but incomplete or not yet fixture-certified
status_values.planned: Not implemented; must be reported as 'Not evaluated' in any result

interface_provenance.browser: verified from static/js source in this repository

layer_0_input_safety.name: Input Safety & Parsing (Layer 0)
layer_0_input_safety.evidence: CSV/JSON parsing present; no file-size or MIME enforcement implemented (no MAX_FILE_SIZE in static/js)

layer_1_input_schema.name: Input Schema Validation (Layer 1)
layer_1_input_schema.evidence: validateRecords() checks required columns and empty values in try-demo.js

layer_2_identifiers_formats.name: Identifier & Format Verification (Layer 2)
layer_2_identifiers_formats.evidence: IBAN mod-97 checksum and per-country length, BIC structure, ISO 4217 currency, YYYY-MM-DD date in try-demo.js

layer_3_xml_syntax_ns.name: XML Syntax & Namespace Validation (Layer 3)
layer_3_xml_syntax_ns.evidence: Browser generates XML but never parses it; no DOMParser usage in static/js

layer_4_xsd_structural.name: XSD Sequence & Cardinality Checks (Layer 4)
layer_4_xsd_structural.evidence: No XSD validation in static/js; the pacs.008 XSD URN appears only as a namespace string in generated output

layer_5_iso_semantic.name: ISO Semantic Consistency (Layer 5)
layer_5_iso_semantic.evidence: No control-sum, transaction-count or cross-field consistency checks in static/js

layer_6_scheme_profile.name: Scheme Profile Rules — CBPR+, CHAPS (Layer 6)
layer_6_scheme_profile.evidence: Postal address classified as fully structured / hybrid / unstructured, plus LEI format (ISO 17442); no wider profile rule set

layer_7_effective_dates.name: Effective-Date Rules — 14 Nov 2026 (Layer 7)
layer_7_effective_dates.evidence: The 2026 deadline is hardcoded in the address classifier; there is no selectable effective date
